Basic ATC

エンジン始動許可

ATC clearance authorizing the aircraft to start its engines, typically when pushback is not required.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is エンジン始動許可?

In this glossary, エンジン始動許可 refers to: ATC clearance authorizing the aircraft to start its engines, typically when pushback is not required.

How is エンジン始動許可 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "エンジン始動許可、滑走路12の待機ポイントへタキシー準備完了時に報告。"

Why does エンジン始動許可 matter in aviation?

エンジン始動許可 matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses エンジン始動許可?

エンジン始動許可 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does エンジン始動許可 belong to?

In this glossary, エンジン始動許可 is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.
